name: aaron_marketing_skills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the aaron_marketing_skills capability.

prompts.name: execute_marketing_skill
prompts.template: Perform the marketing task: {marketing_task} using discipline: {discipline} with command: {command} on content: {content_input}.
prompts.use_case: Creating SEO-optimized content tailored to geographic and topical contexts

prompts.name: audit_marketing_output
prompts.template: Evaluate the following marketing output using auditor gate: {auditor_gate}: {content_input}.
prompts.use_case: Managing influencer marketing campaigns using data-driven skills

prompts.name: generate_marketing_campaign
prompts.template: Create a comprehensive marketing campaign focusing on {discipline} incorporating skills from the shared contract.
prompts.use_case: Generating and optimizing paid advertisements for ROI maximization
